evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen was 8.4 ppm near the established post-purge baseline.
Tube pressure was 3.095 Torr at 100 sccm argon.
Oxygen rose persistently through 17.1 and 22.9 to 30.8 ppm during growth.
Pressure rose persistently through 3.151 and 3.210 to 3.266 Torr despite unchanged setpoints.
Temperature 749.9 C and argon 100.6 sccm track setpoints, while controller still reports running; these do not explain the oxygen and pressure increases.

args.missing_evidence: Independent pressure and oxygen verification plus leak-integrity and exhaust-conductance checks are needed to distinguish air ingress from an exhaust restriction or other process disturbance. No sample characterization is available.
